description: Hold a draft or scheduled post for the owner's approval. Moves it to pending_approval, where it never publishes on its own, emails the owner an Approve link, and returns an approval id to poll with sprkly_get_post_approval_status. Asking again for a post that is already waiting returns the same request. Approved posts go back to scheduled (a post past its time goes out in about 2 minutes); rejected posts become drafts with the owner's notes. To hold a NEW post, pass requires_approval to sprkly_schedule_post instead. Power plan only: other plans get upgrade_required.

note.description: Optional note to the owner, shown in the approval email.

post_id.description: The draft or scheduled post id to hold for approval.

name: sprkly_request_post_approval
title: Request human approval
